sources.title: [PATCH v16 5/6] rust: faux: Allow retrieving a bound Device

claims.claim: When writing up some rust code that used faux devices for unit testing, I noticed that we never actually added the Bound device context to faux::Registration's AsRef implementation. This being said: the Registration object itself is proof that a driver is bound to the device - so this should be safe.
